figurative_meaning_en: To be affected by the evil eye
example_sentences_in_bangla: শিশুটির নজর লেগেছে, তাই হঠাৎ অসুস্থ হয়ে পড়েছে।
নতুন গাড়িটিতে নজর লেগেছে বলে দুর্ঘটনা ঘটেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The child has been struck by the evil eye, that's why he suddenly fell ill.
The new car got the evil eye and met with an accident.
history: This idiom stems from ancient folk beliefs in the evil eye (nazar), a concept prevalent in South Asian and Middle Eastern cultures, often warded off with amulets like black dots or taweez.
note: Commonly used to explain sudden misfortunes, especially for children or new possessions.
